ITEM 1 | Dense bed of loose, dark green leafy greens with thin stems, slightly wilted, ruffled edges, matte with faint moisture, covering roughly 30% of the plate on the left side, about 14 cm tall-spread and 6 cm high mound | 85
ITEM 2 | Bright green broccoli florets with compact tight heads and short pale stems, some florets slightly darker at tips, arranged in a mound about 8 cm across behind and beside the greens, sitting partly on the leafy greens | 70
ITEM 3 | Pale golden-tan cubed chicken pieces, about 2 to 3 cm, with light browning and slightly charred edges, moist and tender surface with a faint sheen, piled in the right-center of the plate beside the rice | 95
ITEM 4 | Light tan cooked rice with separate grains, some clumped and mixed with small flecks of green herb and pinkish-red strands, dry-looking surface, covering about 20% of the right side of the plate, roughly 2 cm high | 80
ITEM 5 | Roasted orange-yellow squash or pumpkin wedges with browned, caramelized edges and darker char lines, firm and slightly glossy, about 4 cm long pieces, placed at the bottom center of the plate beside the greens | 45
ITEM 6 | Thin slices of pinkish-red onion or pickled vegetable strands, glossy and moist, a few pieces about 3 cm long, mixed among the rice near the chicken | 10
